commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s
' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '
== identity ==
'; id; uname -a
printf '
== block devices ==
'; lsblk -o NAME,PATH,SIZE,TYPE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT
printf '
== LVM ==
'; sudo pvs 2>/dev/null || true; sudo vgs 2>/dev/null || true; sudo lvs -a -o lv_name,vg_name,lv_size,lv_path,devices 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
== mounts ==
'; findmnt / /srv/data 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
== fstab ==
'; cat /etc/fstab
printf '
== free ==
'; df -hT
printf '
== disks ==
'; sudo fdisk -l 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,160p'
